    members = ['JonasVautherin', 'dilipchandima', 'dawiss1337', 'bmyun', 'DCMJY']
    for member in members:
        # Fill the username textbox (first textbox in the tree)
        await page.get_by_role('textbox').first.fill(member)
        # Wait for the autocomplete option to appear and click it to select the user
        await page.get_by_role('option', name=member).click()
        # Wait for the 'Add to group' button to become enabled using a JavaScript check
        await page.wait_for_function("""() => {
            const button = document.querySelector('input[value="Add to group"]');
            return button && !button.disabled;
        }""")
        # Click the 'Add to group' button
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Add to group').click()
        # Wait for the action to complete and the page to update
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait for final stability after all additions
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
